note: Runtime artifacts live in src/data and src/selftest/fixtures. Raw zips are included only for reproducibility; they are never loaded by the browser.

datasets.name: ASL Alphabet Hand Landmarks
datasets.author: Boris Graudt
datasets.preprocessing: MediaPipe Hands; 21 3D points; wrist-centered; scaled by maximum wrist distance
datasets.limitation: Held-out frames from the same curated dataset, not signer-independent validation.

datasets.name: KSL hand landmarks
datasets.author: Joan Wachuka
datasets.preprocessing: MediaPipe Hands; two hands; wrist-centered; scale-normalized; resampled to 24 frames
datasets.limitation: Small, non-signer-independent dataset. Four glosses only. Not a KSL lexicon.

datasets.name: BSL-Fingerspelling-Dataset
datasets.author: Alif Sathar
datasets.usedBy: Not bundled. BSL remains rule-based in this build.
datasets.limitation: A permissively licensed BSL landmark corpus has not been curated and reviewed yet. BSL is experimental.

datasets.name: MediaPipe Hands
datasets.author: Google
datasets.limitation: Vendored locally so the recognition path has no runtime CDN dependency.

datasets.name: MARS-KSL benchmark
datasets.author: KSL research community
datasets.usedBy: Reference benchmark only (reported 86.3% frontal accuracy with a trained model).
datasets.limitation: The Zenodo record is access-restricted; it is not bundled.

datasets.name: Kenyan Sign Language (KSL) Video Dataset
datasets.author: eKitabu / Laurette Kazenga
datasets.usedBy: Future work. Not bundled because the licence is non-commercial and the dataset is large.
datasets.limitation: Would require a Deaf-led curation and consent process before use.
